resources.string: Go to discord.com/developers/applications → New Application → name it \"SoundCloud\".\n\nCopy the Application ID shown at the top of the General Information page.

Open Discord in a browser → press F12 → go to the Network tab → filter for "gateway" or reload and look for any request → find the Authorization header value.

Alternatively, open the Console tab and run:

 webpackChunkdiscord_app.push([[…],{},e=>{m=[];for(let c in e.c)m.push(e.c[c])}]);m.find(m=>m?.exports?.default?.getToken).exports.default.getToken()

The token will appear in the console output.
Your token is stored locally and only sent to Discord\'s servers. Never share it with anyone else.
